exam_hub.body_html:
AB-730 is the exam for the Microsoft Certified: AI Business Professional credential. It checks how well you use Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Cowork and prebuilt agents in everyday business work. You do not need to build AI apps or write code. Microsoft rates it at the beginner level.

Key facts

AB-730 key facts from Microsoft Learn
FactOfficial value
Exam length45 minutes (source, checked November 11, 2026)
Passing score700 or higher (source, checked November 11, 2026)
Pricenot published by the vendor (source, checked November 11, 2026) Microsoft sets the price by the country or region where you take the exam.
LanguagesEnglish, Arabic (Saudi Arabia), Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional), French, German, Indonesian (Indonesia), Italian, Korean, Japanese, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Spanish (source, checked November 11, 2026)
FormatProctored exam that may include interactive components (source, checked November 11, 2026)
Number of questionsnot published by the vendor
LevelBeginner (source, checked November 11, 2026)
DeliveryScheduled through Pearson VUE (source, checked November 11, 2026)

Microsoft does not publish a fixed number of questions, so we do not state one. You get 45 minutes, and you need 700 or more to pass.

What the exam covers

The skills outline was last changed on October 20, 2026. It has 4 skill areas:

  • Understand generative AI fundamentals (25 to 30 percent)
  • Manage prompts and chats by using Microsoft 365 Copilot (20 to 25 percent)
  • Manage business content and collaboration by using Microsoft 365 Copilot (20 to 25 percent)
  • Drive business outcomes by using agents (20 to 25 percent)

The largest area is "Understand generative AI fundamentals". See the full skills list for every task.

What changed on October 20, 2026

Microsoft removed the old skill area about creating your own Copilot agents. A new area, "Drive business outcomes by using agents", covers prebuilt agents and Copilot Cowork. Some older study material still shows the previous outline.

Who should take it

It suits people who already use Outlook, Word, Teams, PowerPoint and Excel at work and want to show they can use Copilot well. Microsoft expects you to know prompt basics, how context shapes answers, and common business tasks like drafting email or slides.

Product name note

Microsoft has renamed Microsoft 365 Copilot to Microsoft Copilot. Some exam questions may still use the old name.

Booking and retakes

You book the exam from the Microsoft Learn credential page, which schedules it through Pearson VUE. If you do not pass, you can retake it 24 hours after your first try. Later waits are longer. If the exam is not in your language, you can ask for 30 extra minutes.

objectives.h1: AB-730 Skills Measured: Official Objectives and Weights
objectives.body_html:
This page lists every skill Microsoft measures on AB-730, word for word from the official study guide. The outline is dated October 20, 2026. Weights are ranges, so the exact mix on your exam can vary inside each range.

Weights at a glance

AB-730 skill areas and weights as of October 20, 2026
AreaSkill areaOfficial weight
1Understand generative AI fundamentals25 to 30 percent
2Manage prompts and chats by using Microsoft 365 Copilot20 to 25 percent
3Manage business content and collaboration by using Microsoft 365 Copilot20 to 25 percent
4Drive business outcomes by using agents20 to 25 percent

The low ends add up to 85 percent and the high ends to 105 percent, so the ranges cover the whole exam.

1. Understand generative AI fundamentals

Weight: 25 to 30 percent of the exam. This area has 2 task groups and 8 listed tasks.

1.1 Understand generative AI capabilities across Microsoft 365 experiences

  • Understand how Copilot works to keep your organization's information private and secure
  • Understand how the context, like Work IQ, web data, or the app you're using, can affect Copilot responses
  • Understand when to use Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat, agents, and Microsoft Copilot Cowork
  • Understand the differences in features and capabilities across Copilot experiences and Microsoft 365 apps

1.2 Identify responsible AI and data protection practices

  • Identify common risks, including inaccuracies, prompt injection, and over-reliance
  • Select verification steps appropriate to the task, including citation checks and human review
  • Recognize and mitigate risks to sensitive data
  • Understand how data protection restricts prompt results

2. Manage prompts and chats by using Microsoft 365 Copilot

Weight: 20 to 25 percent of the exam. This area has 2 task groups and 11 listed tasks.

2.1 Create and manage prompts in Microsoft 365 Copilot

  • Understand how to create an effective prompt, including model selection
  • Select appropriate resources to reference in a prompt
  • Save a prompt
  • Schedule a prompt
  • Share a prompt
  • Refine prompts based on generated responses
  • Describe how Copilot uses memory and instructions

2.2 Manage chats in Microsoft 365 Copilot

  • Find a previous chat
  • Delete a chat
  • Rename a chat
  • Organize and share information by using Notebooks

3. Manage business content and collaboration by using Microsoft 365 Copilot

Weight: 20 to 25 percent of the exam. This area has 2 task groups and 11 listed tasks.

3.1 Draft and analyze business content by using Microsoft 365 Copilot

  • Connect to sources beyond Microsoft 365 Copilot by using connectors
  • Generate or analyze content based on specific business context, including Work IQ and connectors
  • Generate images, visuals, and charts to support business content
  • Generate or analyze content across multiple Microsoft 365 applications such as Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, and Microsoft PowerPoint
  • Derive insights across Work IQ
  • Interpret and validate that AI-generated content meets business goals

3.2 Manage meetings and collaboration by using Microsoft 365 Copilot

  • Prepare for a meeting
  • Use the Facilitator agent
  • Use real-time catchup
  • Use Intelligent recap
  • Collaborate on business content by using Copilot Pages

4. Drive business outcomes by using agents

Weight: 20 to 25 percent of the exam. This area has 2 task groups and 11 listed tasks.

4.1 Select and apply prebuilt Microsoft 365 Copilot agents

  • Identify scenarios where a prebuilt agent can improve a business workflow
  • Choose between using a prebuilt agent or creating a custom agent for a business task
  • Apply an agent to a business process from within various Microsoft 365 Copilot experiences
  • Filter chats by agents

4.2 Perform business tasks by using Microsoft Copilot Cowork

  • Describe how Microsoft Copilot Cowork helps carry out multi-step business tasks
  • Understand how Cowork uses skills to complete parts of a task
  • Recognize security considerations and known limitations when using Cowork
  • Choose between prebuilt skills and custom skills
  • Delegate a piece of work to Cowork and a prebuilt skill
  • Review Cowork's plan, progress, and results
  • Manage scheduled tasks or prompts

Changes from the previous outline

  • Create and manage Microsoft 365 Copilot agents: Removed
  • Drive business outcomes by using agents: New
  • Manage prompts and conversations by using AI: Share of the exam decreased

  4. Work through "Drive business outcomes by using agents" (20 to 25 percent). Try each task in Copilot yourself, for example: identify scenarios where a prebuilt agent can improve a business workflow.

title_candidates: AB-730 FAQ: Answers from Microsoft Learn | CertPassly
desc_candidates: AB-730 questions answered from Microsoft Learn: 45 minute length, 700 pass mark, languages, price rules, retakes and what the 4 skill areas cover.
faq.body_html:
Short answers to common AB-730 questions. Each answer comes from Microsoft Learn and links to its source. Where Microsoft has not published a value, we say so.

How long is the AB-730 exam?

You get 45 minutes to finish it. (source)

What score do I need to pass AB-730?

You need a score of 700 or higher. (source)

How many questions are on AB-730?

Microsoft does not publish a fixed number of questions, so we do not give one.

How much does the AB-730 exam cost?

Microsoft sets the price by the country or region where you take the exam. Check the price when you book. (source)

Which languages is AB-730 offered in?

It is offered in English, Arabic (Saudi Arabia), Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional), French, German, Indonesian (Indonesia), Italian, Korean, Japanese, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian and Spanish. (source)

Can I get extra time if AB-730 is not in my language?

Yes. Microsoft says you can request 30 extra minutes in that case. (source)

When can I retake AB-730 if I fail?

You can retake it 24 hours after your first attempt. Later retakes have longer waits. (source)

Are there prerequisites for AB-730?

Microsoft lists no formal prerequisite. It expects you to know Microsoft 365 apps and basic prompting.

What skill areas does AB-730 cover?

There are 4 areas: Understand generative AI fundamentals (25 to 30 percent); Manage prompts and chats by using Microsoft 365 Copilot (20 to 25 percent); Manage business content and collaboration by using Microsoft 365 Copilot (20 to 25 percent); Drive business outcomes by using agents (20 to 25 percent). (source)

Does the exam still say Microsoft 365 Copilot?

It may. Microsoft renamed the product to Microsoft Copilot, and some questions can still use the old name. (source)

Does the Microsoft Certified: AI Business Professional credential expire?

The credential page does not say. We will update this answer when Microsoft publishes a rule.

certification.body_html:
Microsoft Certified: AI Business Professional is a beginner level Microsoft credential for people who use Microsoft 365 Copilot in daily business work. You earn it by passing one exam, AB-730.

Requirements

Microsoft Certified: AI Business Professional requirements
ItemOfficial detail
Required examAB-730 (the only exam listed)
LevelBeginner
RolesAdministrator, Business User
Prerequisitesnot stated by the vendor
Validitynot stated by the vendor
Renewalnot stated by the vendor
Official pageMicrosoft Learn credential page (checked November 11, 2026)

Microsoft does not state an expiry or renewal rule on this credential page. Its general rule says associate, expert and specialty certifications expire each year, but this page does not place this credential in those groups.

Who it is for

Microsoft aims the exam at business users of generative AI tools such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Cowork and prebuilt agents. You do not build AI apps or write code. The exam lasts 45 minutes and you need a score of 700 to pass.

What the exam measures

The AB-730 study guide groups the skills into 4 areas. The largest share goes to understand generative ai fundamentals, at 25 to 30 percent.

  • Understand generative AI fundamentals: 25 to 30 percent
  • Manage prompts and chats by using Microsoft 365 Copilot: 20 to 25 percent
  • Manage business content and collaboration by using Microsoft 365 Copilot: 20 to 25 percent
  • Drive business outcomes by using agents: 20 to 25 percent
